task: Create a Part::Box object in the document at /home/user/Documents/part.FCStd. Set its dimensions to Length=40 mm, Width=30 mm, Height=20 mm. Set its Label to 'MainBlock'. Save the file.
task_grounding: FreeCAD is open with the file /home/user/Documents/part.FCStd (currently an empty document). Switch to the Part workbench (View > Workbench > Part, or select Part from the workbench dropdown). Use Part > Primitives > Cube (or the Box toolbar button) to add a Part::Box object. In the Data tab of the Property panel, set Length to 40 mm, Width to 30 mm, and Height to 20 mm. Then change the object's Label (also in the Data tab, or by double-clicking the name in the Model tree) to exactly 'MainBlock'. Save the file with Ctrl+S so it is written back to /home/user/Documents/part.FCStd.
